mxtrain_text:
MODEL RegressorProject.mxai

DATASET RegressorTrainingSet
  SOURCE csv("regressor.train.csv")
  INPUT Input FROM COLUMNS [centigrados]
  TARGET predicted_value: Scalar
  SPLIT train=0.8 validation=0.2 seed=42
  BATCH size=8
END

LOSS RegressorLoss
  TYPE mse
  PREDICTION Regressor
  TARGET predicted_value
END

OPTIMIZER RegressorOptimizer
  TYPE sgd
  LEARNING_RATE 0.01
  UPDATE Regressor.*
END

RUN
  EPOCHS 50
END
